brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Japanese basketball editorial article thumbnail, ONE final landscape PNG, 16:9, requested 2048 x 1152 pixels.
Primary request: Design a bold and beautiful thumbnail for the article「10/30 試合結果（公式記録の確定待ち）」. All games in the fixed source are awaiting official confirmation as of 2026-10-30 20:17 JST. This is the essential editorial meaning and must be unmistakable.
Style: Deep near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm ivory lettering, one orange basketball. Thick Japanese gothic typography, textured hand-drawn ink, dry-brush strokes, restrained ink flecks. Strong editorial clarity and very few elements. The approved style was inspected: large white Japanese headline on black, lime accent brush and expressive ink illustration. Use this visual language only; no old player names, dates, teams or stats.
Subject: A single large orange basketball, fully in frame, on the right, rendered as a graphic hand-drawn ink illustration. Sparse court arc lines below the ball, and one energetic diagonal lime brush behind it. No people, no faces, no hands, no player silhouettes, no arena or real game scene.
Composition: Left two-thirds dominated by very large text; right third by the ball. All text horizontal, correctly spelled Japanese, crisp and immediately readable. Clean safe margins of at least 5% around every text line. No overlap between ball and text. No crowded panels. Flat artwork filling the image, no mockup frame.
Text (verbatim; render exactly these six lines, no other text):
"10/30 試合結果"
"公式記録の"
"確定待ち"
"2026年10月30日 20:17 JST時点"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Typography hierarchy: Line 1 at top-left in bold ivory, approximately 90 px at 2048px wide. Lines 2 and 3 form the main headline in the middle-left; line 2 bold ivory approximately 140 px, line 3 bold lime approximately 180 px. The word「確定待ち」must be the strongest visual message. Line 4 beneath the headline in clearly readable ivory approximately 40 px. Lines 5 and 6 at bottom-left, small but clearly legible ivory approximately 32 px, on separate lines or one well-spaced footer row, with full safe margins.
Constraints: State only the pending status from the fixed article. Do not invent scores, rankings, performances, winners, final results, live status or shots. No EFF values, no athlete names, no teams, no numbers except the exact date/time text. No logos, sponsor text, badges, watermarks, photography, photorealism, or additional explanatory wording. The two AI illustration footer labels are required verbatim. The ball is a generic symbolic illustration and does not depict an actual event.
